// @path: src/app/ops/schools/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-REQUIRE-OPERATOR
// The guard scan matched `export default function` and `export const x = () =>`
// and missed the anonymous default arrow entirely, so this page had no guard
// and no violation.
import { listSchoolsForOps } from "@/lib/ops/reads";

export default async (props) => {
  const schools = await listSchoolsForOps();
  return <main>{schools.length}</main>;
};
